column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: two tests in auth/a_operator_key_lifecycle_test.go, each looping DialectPostgres/MySQL/MSSQL, so mysql and mssql skip in this PostgreSQL-only job while postgres RUNS -- four, not six. The direct sibling of this package's ^TestExpiredKeyCannotAuthenticate/(mysql|mssql)$ line above (cleat#2352): same file family, same shape, one testutil.TestDB gate per subtest rather than a single gate at the top of the parent, so the parent reports PASS and each dialect subtest reports its own skip. Measured by NAME, not by delta: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES=<pg> go test ./auth/ -run 'AnOperatorKeyRoundTripsOnEveryDialect|AnExpiredOperatorKeyCannotAuthenticate' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these four and 0 failures; with all three DSNs set it reads zero, which is why this is not derived from a delta. cleat#2169: the operator credential's storage is per-dialect SQL, so the tests that EXECUTE it -- rather than assert its shape -- run wherever the job has a DSN.
